inspect.purpose: inspect the latest CUTOVER snapshot against current project/device/plan/source facts without acquiring business write locks

lockAndRevalidate.transaction: PROPAGATION_REQUIRED; joins the CUT write transaction; locks and revalidates the selected immutable snapshot and current Owner facts
lockAndRevalidate.purpose: guard CUT create or continuation with exact snapshot and device expectations

trustedTenant: query.tenantId must equal TenantContextHolder.getRequiredTenantId before Owner access; no tenant switching

common.expectedDevices: NON_EMPTY; sorted by deviceId; unique deviceId and trim+Locale.ROOT-uppercase serial comparison key
common.expectedDevice: {deviceId POSITIVE_LONG, serialNumber normalized nonblank max128, projectAssignmentVersion NON_NEGATIVE_LONG}

inputContract.forbidden: caller supplied project/source/approved-plan facts, opaque watermark, hash or partial device set

outputContract.snapshot: immutable CUTOVER snapshot fact including tenant/project/snapshot identity and version, frozen context, decision, sorted unmetCodes and evaluatedAt

context.devices: non-empty stable device facts sorted by deviceId
context.sourceFacts: exactly EXE_01, EXE_02, EXE_03, EXE_04 sorted by sourceCode

outputContract.sourceFact: strict union: EXE_01 uses ACCEPTED|NOT_COMPLETED; EXE_02..04 use COMPLETED|NOT_COMPLETED. ACCEPTED/COMPLETED require non-empty stable sourceObjectIds and watermarkEntries. NOT_COMPLETED permits both collections empty when no source fact exists, or both non-empty for a partial/failed existing fact; placeholders are forbidden. reopened is explicit
outputContract.watermarkEntry: {axisCode stable UPPER_SNAKE max64, objectId POSITIVE_LONG, version NON_NEGATIVE_LONG}; no hash or opaque JSON
outputContract.ready: only EXE_01=ACCEPTED, EXE_02..04=COMPLETED and all reopened=false; snapshot decision READY, frozen and current context equal, currentUnmetCodes empty
outputContract.notReady: any otherwise valid source fact combination, including missing source or reopened=true, must use snapshot decision NOT_READY with frozen/current context equal and the same non-empty unmetCodes
outputContract.stale: snapshot remains immutable; staleReasonCodes non-empty; currentContext may be null only when no complete current scope can be returned without partial facts

consumerMapping.READY: CUT may continue its own guarded command
consumerMapping.OWNER_DATA_CORRUPTED: internal failure; never masquerade as READY, NOT_READY or STALE

controlledSimulation.allowed: F-CUT-002 unit and integration test assembly may provide deterministic READY and NOT_READY doubles after this contract passes
controlledSimulation.forbidden: no double in src/main or production Bean assembly; no simulated fact is Owner completion, real browser evidence or Implementation Done
